title.narrative: Evaluation of the Land Administration Reform

description.narrative: A team from Michigan State University is conducting outreach and planning for a land tenure project in Lesotho. The program is funding evaluations of the Land Administration Reform Activity, which is set to deliver formally recognized titles to land assets of 55,000 urban households. The impact evaluation team is working to conduct outreach, develop impact evaluation design, develop and work plan and prepare for implementation.

person-name.narrative: Daniel Herche and Tyson Whitney; Ryan Boles

description.narrative: The Food for Progress Program provides for the donation of U.S. agricultural commodities to developing countries and emerging democracies that are committed to introducing or expanding free enterprise in their agricultural economies. The program has two primary strategic objectives: (1) increase agricultural productivity and (2) expand trade of agricultural products.
